entries.title: Prevent SimHash feature vote overflow
entries.problem: Signed 8-bit counters overflow within the existing 256-feature sampling budget, collapsing repeated-message sketches and causing unrelated messages to collide.
entries.change: Use signed 16-bit vote counters while preserving sampling and the serialized sketch format.
entries.regression_coverage: Repeated Latin and CJK shingles across signed-counter and sampling boundaries, plus unrelated-message separation.
entries.duplicate_screening: Original feature #2266; no matching overflow correction found.
entries.pr_title: fix: prevent SimHash feature vote overflow
entries.pr_body:
## Problem

Signed 8-bit counters overflow within the existing 256-feature sampling budget, collapsing repeated-message sketches and causing unrelated messages to collide.

## Changes

Use signed 16-bit vote counters while preserving sampling and the serialized sketch format.

## Regression coverage

The new suite checks repeated Latin and CJK shingles across 127/128 and 255/256 votes and across stride changes, plus distinct unrelated sketches at the 256-feature cap.

## Validation

Regression tests are included. GitHub Actions has not run on this commit.

## Related work

Original feature #2266; no matching overflow correction found.

entries.title: Retain failed dump deletions in GC byte accounting
entries.problem: Retention subtracts bytes even when unlink fails, allowing retained dumps to exceed the configured budget.
entries.change: Keep failed aged deletions among survivors and charge their bytes until deletion actually succeeds.
entries.regression_coverage: Deterministic EPERM unlink failure under both byte-only and combined age/byte policies; removable newer files still bring retained bytes under the cap.

entries.title: Cancel idle raw upstream reads on client disconnect
entries.problem: Raw streaming can wait forever on an idle upstream reader after the downstream client disconnects.

entries.title: Honor backpressure and completion when dumping SSE streams
entries.problem: SSE dumps ignore write backpressure and resolve before file completion, while sink failures leave source readers active.
entries.change: Use Node stream pipeline to coordinate backpressure, completion and error cancellation.
entries.regression_coverage: Blocked low-watermark writable retains bounded read-ahead, final-flush completion is awaited, and a failing destination cancels/unlocks the upstream.
entries.duplicate_screening: Related #113, #787, #2351 and #2356 do not provide this sink coordination. A separately created Web Streams tee may still buffer its slower branch.

entries.title: Evict watermark sessions incrementally at cache capacity
entries.problem: Admitting session 1,025 clears every existing watermark handshake.
entries.change: Evict only the least recently used session and refresh recency when a known session is captured or used.
entries.regression_coverage: A full 1,024-session table retains all but the oldest entry, refreshes recency on emit/capture/learn, and does not allocate slots for unknown reads.
entries.duplicate_screening: Inspected pending protocol PRs #5652 and #5855; both leave the full-clear capacity behavior unchanged.
